content.overview: Article 216 provides that every High Court shall consist of a Chief Justice and such other Judges as the President may from time to time deem it necessary to appoint.
content.glance: HC = Chief Justice + such other Judges as the President may appoint.
content.study:
Article 216 is the composition clause. Strength is not fixed in the Constitution; the President determines the number of Judges as necessary. Appointment process is governed by Article 217 and the collegium system as developed in judicial decisions.

Examination: CJ + other Judges; President determines strength; link Art 217.

sections.heading: Key rule
